answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can be enforced by requiring every participating agent to bond a refundable collateral deposit registered at the network summit. A Byzantine agent’s stake is slashed if verification proves misconduct, so an attacker controlling an ocean of fake identities must fund each one separately. Because ephemeral comet-like nodes cannot share a single bond, the attack cost scales linearly with identity count, making mass Sybil creation economically irrational.
